## Next bounded AP05 change: executable single-part f-string reuse

CompileFormattedParts always emits final join,including one already-formatted
PyString. The runtime builder then allocates/copies it again. Three short public
probes show matching text but different CPython identity for ordinary/native and
custom formatter strings through both APIs. Treat identity reuse as an observed
CPython optimization,not a universal immutable-string identity guarantee.

For join.Count==1,leave the existing observed/funded text on the operand stack.
Remove that execution's builder/copy/preflight overlap;keep the join instruction,
fuel/span checkpoint and all field/conversion/specifier/protocol operations.
No compiler change,new opcode,owner,cache or lazy-buffer tracking. Empty/multi-
part joins and the incremental lowered route keep their current behavior.
Document lower allocation/earlier success and retained input/result aliases;
no general formatting rewrite. Existing field observation must prove funding.

Before editing freeze one short native allocation/work pair:single native/text,
custom formatter,conversion/dynamic-specifier forms;empty/multi-part and lowered
controls. Require exact work/error/fuel/spans and unchanged control allocations;
qualify alias/result retention,real formatter/descriptor I/O,cancellation,refusal
and multi-part join rejection. Reuse existing formatting/owner tests and58 jobs.
Stop at this single executable join;if owner transfer/new policy is needed,reject.
No timing campaign. Evidence/pins:
`.git/agent-notes/single-part-fstring-c891dc8c/source-screen.json`.
